rows.grounds: gerundive adjective describing the goddess as deserving worship
instrumental expressing the manner in which worship is to be performed
compound: sarva-īpsita-phala-pradā, describing the goddess as bestowing all wished-for results

items.question: What manner of worship and what boon does the goddess merit from devotees?
premises: The goddess is worthy of worship.
Her worship must be performed with diligent effort.
She grants all desired fruits to her devotees.
items.inference: Therefore the goddess merits diligent worship because she bestows all desired fruits.
items.plain_english: She is worthy of worship with diligent effort, for she grants all desired fruits.
